sermon.title: The Other Side of Eternal Life
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that eternal life has two sides: believing in Christ and obeying Him. He reads John 17:3 and 1 John 2 on what it means to know God, and Matthew 7:21-27 on the many who say “Lord, Lord” but do not do the Father’s will.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: the captions garble the name of the seven sons in Acts 19:14-16 (the sons of Sceva in the Bible); it is marked [unclear] in the transcript rather than guessed, and the line the sons speak at about 13:35 is also garbled and marked [unclear]. He gives “Daniel chapter 12:2” and reads on through verse 3; “he that winneth souls is wise” is Proverbs 11:30 and is not named by him. He says “Paul said this in Acts” (Acts 20:27) and “Matthew 19:16.” He says “John 12:48” and then “John 5:24” in an order that follows his reading. “Burl” in the captions is written as “burial.” He says the Greek word translated “ought” means a debt, and “you can go to your Hebrew and Greek all day”; the Greek claims are his as spoken. About 17:30 he says “there’s nothing wrong with adultery, there’s nothing wrong with homosexuality” about his opponents’ views, and he says “you’re going to hell” about people who do not grow up in Christ; these are his words as spoken. He mentions “uncalled, bad preachers” without naming anyone.

chunks.section_question: What is the first side of eternal life, and do demons go to heaven? (John 3:16, James 2:19, John 3:36)

chunks.short_answer: He says Christianity “starts at a baby stage,” then grows to a fatherhood stage, “and while we’re reaching the fatherhood stage, we’re still justified before God.” He says “I am pursuing the goal, and I’m not agreeing that wrong is right.”
chunks.text: and we keep repenting and we keep confessing. They just say there’s nothing wrong with adultery, there’s nothing wrong with homosexuality, nothing wrong. You see, that’s the difference. So don’t go jumping on Christians that are growing in God. Christianity, the Bible says, starts at a baby stage, then we grow to a child stage, and to an adolescent stage, and then an adult stage, and into a fatherhood stage. And while we’re reaching the fatherhood stage, we’re still justified before God. We haven’t grown through some stages yet. Are you there? So see, that’s why the Bible says there’s no condemnation. Why? I am in the growing process. Yes, I’ve got some flaws, but I am pursuing the goal, and I’m not agreeing that wrong is right, even if I’m doing it.

Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

faqs.question: What does he say is the first part of eternal life?
faqs.answer: He says “believing in Christ, putting your trust in Christ, His death on the cross, forgiveness of sins, cleansing of sins, and you will have everlasting life.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.

faqs.question: Does he say demons go to heaven?
faqs.answer: He says “Do demons go to heaven? No, they don’t. We know that the lake of fire was made for Satan and his angels.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: You believe that there is one God. You do well. Even the demons believe—and tremble!

faqs.question: What does he say about people who do not believe the Son?
faqs.answer: He says “the wrath of God abides on them.” He means those who “believe on what He did, but they’re not believing and trusting in keeping what He said.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: He who believes in the Son has everlasting life; and he who does not believe the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abides on him.”

faqs.question: What does he say will judge people?
faqs.answer: He says “What’s going to judge people? The word that He spoke.” He adds, “the same word shall judge him in the last day.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: For I have not shunned to declare to you the whole counsel of God.

faqs.question: Why does he say some are raised to shame and contempt?
faqs.answer: He says “they’re not turning to righteousness,” and “righteousness is going to determine whether you are resurrected for honor or shame and contempt.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Those who are wise shall shine Like the brightness of the firmament, And those who turn many to righteousness Like the stars forever and ever.

faqs.question: What did Jesus tell the rich man?
faqs.answer: He says Jesus replied, “If you want to enter into eternal life, keep the commandments.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now behold, one came and said to Him, “Good Teacher, what good thing shall I do that I may have eternal life?” So He said to him, “Why do you call Me good? No one is good but One, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.” He said to Him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder,’ ‘You shall not commit adultery,’ ‘You shall not steal,’ ‘You shall not bear false witness,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ ”

faqs.question: Does he say we no longer need to believe in Jesus if we obey?
faqs.answer: He says “No. That’s the first step of eternal life, is believing in Jesus… The second part is what? Obeying Him.”

faqs.question: What does he say about Bible morality?
faqs.answer: He says “Bible morality has always been the goal, not you just believing.”

faqs.question: What is the Bible’s definition of eternal life, according to him?
faqs.answer: He reads “This is eternal life, that you may know God, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom God has sent,” and says “eternal life is to know God and Jesus Christ.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.

faqs.question: What does he say it means to know God?
faqs.answer: He says “this is eternal life, that we keep His commandments, God’s commandments and the commandments of Jesus Christ.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: He who says, “I know Him,” and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

faqs.question: What does the word “ought” mean, according to him?
faqs.answer: He says “The word ‘ought’ means very necessary, so necessary they use it as owing a debt.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: He who says he abides in Him ought himself also to walk just as He walked.

faqs.question: Does he say Christians are condemned for their flaws?
faqs.answer: He says “That’s why the Bible says there’s no condemnation,” because “I am in the growing process.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who do not walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

faqs.question: Does he say miracles prove someone is godly?
faqs.answer: He says “you don’t measure them by whether they do miracles and cast out demons. You measure them by their fruit, their lifestyle, how they live.”

faqs.question: Is hearing and believing enough?
faqs.answer: He says “just hearing and believing isn’t enough. You’ve got to what? Do them.”
